title: Federal learning modeling method, apparatus, system, device, and medium
assignee: Shengdoushi Shanghai Science and Technology Development Co Ltd

pse.problem: The invention aims to address the challenge of performing machine learning tasks while maintaining user privacy protection and data security in a federated learning environment with multiple participants.
pse.solution_function: The method performs a federated learning modeling task between a first participant and at least one second participant. The first participant uses a model (first model) to perform online predictions, which generates first data. The second participant also uses a separate model (second model), and their contributions generate second data. A training dataset is constructed using both the first and second data. The first model is then updated (third model) based on this dataset. A fourth model is determined based on the performance of both the first and third models, and the first participant continues to use the fourth model for online predictions while the second participant uses the second model.
pse.solution_structure: The solution consists of a first training module within a device that coordinates federated learning tasks between multiple participants, generating and updating models, and constructing training datasets.
pse.solution_implementation: The online prediction process involves cooperation between the first participant and at least one second participant using their respective models to perform predictions. The training process updates the first model based on the constructed training dataset, and a fourth model is determined based on the performance of both the first and updated models.
pse.effect: The invention results in continued online prediction while maintaining user privacy and data security, as well as potential improvements in model performance through iterative updates.
